script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'anatomy-probe',
  description: 'Tiny probe workflow to study on-disk artifacts',
  phases: [{ title: 'Probe', detail: 'three trivial agents' }],
}
const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: { word: { type: 'string' }, n: { type: 'integer' } },
  required: ['word', 'n'],
  additionalProperties: false,
}
phase('Probe')
log('anatomy probe starting')
const out = await parallel([1,2,3].map(i => () =>
  agent(`Return the word "probe${i}" and the number ${i*10}. Do nothing else.`,
        {label: `probe-${i}`, phase: 'Probe', schema: SCHEMA})))
log(`probe done: ${out.filter(Boolean).length} agents`)
return { collected: out }
summary: Tiny probe workflow to study on-disk artifacts

workflowProgress.label: probe-1
workflowProgress.promptPreview: Return the word "probe1" and the number 10. Do nothing else.

workflowProgress.label: probe-2
workflowProgress.promptPreview: Return the word "probe2" and the number 20. Do nothing else.
